Plan your visit
You are warmly welcome to the world of Kazerne. Plan your visit and experience it all under one roof: come taste, stay the night, meet others, and get inspired by leading design.
Home
|
Visit
Address
Kazerne
Grote Berg 9, 5611 KH
Paradijslaan 2-8, 5611 KN
Downtown Eindhoven
The Netherlands
Kazerne is located on the corner of Grote Berg and Paradijslaan in the centre of Eindhoven, within walking distance of
Eindhoven Central Station
and only 15 minutes from
Eindhoven Airport
. Several bus stops and parking facilities are available nearby.
Plan your route
Contact
One Home, Two Engines, Three Addresses, Multiple Functions
Opening hours
Kazerne ByDay
Daily from 7:30 AM – 5:00 PM
Kazerne Restaurant
Monday to Wednesday 5:00 – 8:30 PM
Thursday to Saturday 12:00 – 9:00 PM
‍
Group reservations
Possible daily 7:30 AM – 2:00 AM
‍
Book a table
Exhibition
Kazerne Design Lab
Daily from 7:30 until closing time
Open/Private
Some spaces may be privately booked. Please contact us before your visit to ensure the full exhibition is accessible.
book a tour
Contact
Entrance & Tickets
Exhibitions
Entrance to our exhibitions is usually free. Only for special events, such as during Dutch Design Week, we may ask for a small ticket fee. Details can always be found in the agenda.
Activities
Many activities are also free of charge, though sometimes we ask you to reserve a seat so we can plan for your visit. Details can be found in the agenda as well.
‍
Agenda
Accessibility
Visitors with reduced mobility
Most spaces are accessible for wheelchairs. Including the bathroom
Contact
Come visit, eat, drink or even stay the night – and get inspired

350m distance –
4 minutes walking

Frederik van Eedenplein
350m distance –

Q-park Stadhuisplein 07:00 – 23:00, ride out 24/7
Stadhuisplein
150m distance –
2 minutes walking
Parking area Keizersgracht
Access Keizersgracht
‍
Park your Bike
Park your bike across Kazerne at the Grote Berg or the secure bicycle parking at
the Heuvel
, 400m distance, 5 minute walking distance.
Park your Bus
Bus and Coach Parking
Guests can be dropped off at the loading zone between Paradijslaan 2 and 8.
‍
Vans
can be parked at
Frederik van Eedenplein
.
Touring coaches and trucks
are welcome to park at the TU grounds (southern side road of Onze Lieve Vrouwestraat, between John F. Kennedylaan and Dommel) or in the Irisbuurt on Gabriël Metsulaan (between Lucas Gasselstraat and Kanaaldijk-Zuid).
Do you have a
sleeper coach
? Just ask us about the friendly arrangements we have in place.
